# viettelcloud_custom_image (Data Source)

Get a Viettel Cloud custom image by UUID or a unique combination of name, volume, region, operating system, version, state, and status.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "viettelcloud_custom_image" "example" {
  name   = "my-custom-image"
  region = "vn-central-1"
  status = "active"
  state  = "enabled"
}
output "custom_image_id" {
  value = data.viettelcloud_custom_image.example.id
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `id` (String) Image UUID. Exactly one image must match all configured criteria.
- `name` (String) Image name. Exactly one image must match all configured criteria.
- `os` (String) Operating system. Exactly one image must match all configured criteria.
- `region` (String) Region name. Exactly one image must match all configured criteria.
- `state` (String) Image state: enabled or disabled. Exactly one image must match all configured criteria.
- `status` (String) Backend image status. Exactly one image must match all configured criteria.
- `version` (String) Operating system version. Exactly one image must match all configured criteria.
- `volume` (String) Source volume name. Exactly one image must match all configured criteria.
- `volume_id` (String) Source volume UUID. Exactly one image must match all configured criteria.

### Read-Only

- `container_format` (String) Image container format.
- `created_at` (String) Creation time in RFC3339 format.
- `description` (String) Image description.
- `disk_format` (String) Image disk format.
- `encrypt_key_size` (String) Encryption key size reported by the API.
- `metadata` (String) Image metadata as a JSON object returned by the API.
- `min_volume_size` (Number) Minimum volume size reported by the API.
- `owner` (String) Owner username. Null when the API omits the owner.
- `owner_id` (String) Owner user UUID. Null when the API omits the owner.
- `project` (String) Owner project name.
- `project_id` (String) Owner project UUID.
- `shared_project_ids` (Set of String) Project UUIDs that can use this image.
- `size` (Number) Image size reported by the API.
- `updated_at` (String) Last update time in RFC3339 format.
